Directory

Trycord instances

These are the Trycord instances this one knows about. An entry is a pointer, not a verdict: whether an instance is reachable, whether it accepts registrations and whether it speaks this protocol are facts the instance itself confirms, and this page does not claim otherwise.

How this list works

What an entry is

A pointer, not a verdict

A directory may say an instance accepts registrations, and it may say an instance is verified. Both are claims. This page shows the claim and names it as a claim; the instance's own document is what settles it.

Only what an operator has published

An instance appears here because whoever runs this one has listed it. Nothing about an instance is published here without the operator of that instance agreeing to it first.

Running one yourself

An account belongs to the instance that made it, so a session never crosses between instances. If none of these suit you, self-hosting takes a few minutes.
